shots.prompt:
Shot on pushed 35mm with increased grain and desaturation. Medium focal length, slightly claustrophobic framing. Vanity mirror ring of bare amber bulbs as key light, flat ambient fill. Faded rose wallpaper, cheap fluorescent white, deep red velvet. Amber cigarette smoke in backstage air. Upscale Chinese nightclub backroom. Nan Goldin backstage document crossed with Jim Goldberg documentary tension. Photorealistic.

Candid documentary still, not staged. Present-continuous verbs. Specific physical tells only: half-raised brow, pressed lips, dilated pupils, corner-of-eye glance, jaw tension, lower lip pressing inward, nostril flare, chin drop, Adam's apple swallowing once, knuckles whitening, slow blink hold. Never use interpretive emotion words like composed, mysterious, sensual, seductive, predatory, amused, alluring. Body language: weight shift, hands mid-gesture, gaze directed at object or middle distance. Strict anatomy: all mouths stay closed; lips sealed; no teeth; no mouth interior. ECU anatomy hygiene. Shot Design: one shot does one thing.

Meijie (early 50s, severe Chinese woman, black lacquered chignon with silver streaks, sharp cheekbones, long thin fingers, emerald silk cheongsam slit to thigh): slender cigarette held between closed lips, smoke curling past her eye. This signature ONLY appears here because Meijie is in frame.

Tier 2 motifs: faded rose floral wallpaper peeling near ceiling, vanity mirror with ring of half-burnt bulbs, spilled makeup and lipstick on formica, cheap tungsten warmth, doorway to stage area with magenta/gold club lights bleeding in, Chinese nightclub signage through far doorway.

Tier 3 (shot-level): door frame dark edges 40% of frame foreground, Meijie seen at vanity mirror through the gap, emerald cheongsam catching vanity bulb ring light, faded rose wallpaper visible in gap.

Mid-moment: Meijie leans at vanity mirror, cigarette steady between closed lips, smoke column rising past her eye, hands mid-gesture near cosmetics, gaze directed toward mirror reflection (not toward camera), weight shifted on one leg. Tells in frame: slow blink hold, nostril flare on inhale, lower lip pressing inward around cigarette. Captured as if shot by Nan Goldin for backstage documentary—observer frame, Wong Kar-wai spatial hesitation implied by the doorway gap.
shots.high_risk_notes: Meijie cigarette signature ACTIVATED—she is in frame. Class E containment: this signature does NOT carry to shots 02, 03, or 04.
